note: PROVEN entries were confirmed by directly reading the cited source file(s) in this worktree. NOT_FOUND entries were searched for with bounded, targeted queries per the discovery-ceiling instruction (three bounded passes) and not located. UNKNOWN entries could not be conclusively classified within the discovery ceiling. Never inferred from the feature name alone.

entryPoint.function: the request handler (Deno.serve callback) in index.ts; ~3389 lines, orchestrates auth, context assembly, model call, output validation, and persistence for one StyleChat/Elise turn
entryPoint.note: Bounded discovery ceiling: index.ts was read in targeted slices (entitlement gating, advice-pipeline invocation) rather than traced end-to-end line by line.

recommendationPath.function: runEliseAdvicePipeline (eliseAdvicePipeline.ts) orchestrates: classifyEliseAdviceIntent -> retrieveAuthorizedWardrobeCandidates -> resolveEliseFocusedItem -> rankAndBoundCandidates -> analyzeWardrobeGap / buildPurchaseAdvice / buildMultiLooks -> buildEliseAdvicePromptBlock / buildEliseAdviceMetadata
recommendationPath.note: This deterministic pipeline is the SAME pipeline that implements 'Wardrobe Concierge' behavior when the conciergeV1 flag is on (see conciergeSourceMap.json). Elise and Concierge are not two codebases; Concierge is an additive, flag-gated capability layer inside this one pipeline. Recorded per source authority, not per feature name (spec section 13).

modelRouter.details: resolveEliseModels reads STYLECHAT_GEMINI_MODEL / STYLECHAT_GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL env vars, validated against an APPROVED_MODELS allowlist and a retired-model denylist shared with Scanner/TextScan. classifyHttpFailure/isDirectFallbackFailure/isRepairableFailure define the provider-failure taxonomy (timeout/network/429/5xx -> direct fallback; empty/malformed/incomplete -> one same-model repair then fallback).
modelRouter.provider: Gemini (Google), per repo-wide convention recorded in project memory (project_stylechat_gemini) and confirmed by the 'gemini' provider literal in eliseGenerationTypes-adjacent persistence code (persistAssistantOnce writes provider: 'gemini').

systemPromptSource.details: System prompt is assembled from a fixed trust-separated envelope: KSCAN_SYSTEM_TRUST_RULES (promptEnvelope.ts, constant) + optional trustedServerContext, with every dynamic value (Closet, Signature Style, visual context, commerce, shared-room, conversation history) placed in explicitly-tagged UNTRUSTED sections via buildEnvelopeSection/assemblePromptEnvelope. buildStructuredGroundingSystemBlock (eliseStructuredGrounding.ts) is the higher-level assembler actually used by the Elise turn, folding in Signature Style, weather, visual context, and the E-4 advice prompt block from buildEliseAdvicePromptBlock. Persona name resolution (buildStylistPersonaBlock, stylistIdentity.ts) is a separate, small, server-controlled block.

contextInputs.closet: eliseWardrobeRetrieval.ts (retrieveAuthorizedWardrobeCandidates) — actor-scoped, source-typed (closet/saved_scan/recent_scan/owned_room/shared_room/saved_product/commerce_product/inspiration/focused_scan) candidates with an explicit actorRelationship (owned/saved/scanned/shared/discovered/unverified/unknown).
contextInputs.signatureStyle: styleDnaContext.ts — TWO independent signals: (1) client-fed local feedback-signal counts (parseStyleDnaContext / buildStyleDnaContextBlock, gated on STYLE_DNA_MIN_SIGNALS=3), and (2) server-derived aggregate Closet-evidence profile (buildServerStyleDnaProfileBlock, StyleDnaProfileDataV1 — color/category/garmentType/brand/material frequency only, never raw item text).
contextInputs.conversationHistory: contextMessages.ts (selectRecentModelContextMessages) selects the newest non-greeting messages (bounded window) from the persisted style_chat_messages table for the model context; confirms MULTI_TURN_SUPPORTED at the persistence/context layer.
contextInputs.explicitUserRequest: input.message, bounded/sanitized via _shared/aiSecurity/inputLimits.ts (boundTextField, AI_INPUT_LIMITS.eliseUserMessage = 500 chars) before entering the prompt envelope as an untrusted_user section.
contextInputs.weather: weatherContext, serialized and truncated to 400 chars, passed into the advice pipeline as weatherSummary and into the structured grounding block as an untrusted server-verified-context section.
contextInputs.constraints: Not a first-class structured field; constraints are extracted informally from free text (e.g. noShopping regex in eliseAdvicePipeline.ts: /\b(without\s+buying|no\s+shopping|closet\s+only)\b/i) and from occasion/season token extraction. No dedicated 'constraints' object reaches the prompt.
contextInputs.entitlementState: hasActiveKPlusForWardrobeContext (index.ts), derived from a server-side has_active_k_plus() check; also gates RLS visibility of user_closet_items directly (see entitlementMap.json).

outputShape.details: validateEliseGenerationOutput produces { text, explanation, actions, metadata: { outputVersion, usedFallback, validationOutcome } }. Actions are allowlisted app-action types only (open_stylist, style_anchor_item, style_for_event, restyle_outfit, swap_item, open_look, ask_my_room); SQL/RPC/storage/mutation-shaped action types and any url/href field are dropped. The advice pipeline additionally produces EliseAdviceOutput (adviceIntent, focusedItem, recommendations[], wardrobeGap, purchaseAdvice, looks, contractVersion, and — Concierge only — wardrobeContextMode/focusAmbiguity).

failurePath.details: Provider failures classified by modelRouting.ts (isDirectFallbackFailure / isRepairableFailure) drive fallback-model selection. eliseGenerationResilience.test.ts and eliseProviderRetry.ts cover a resilience/idempotency layer keyed on (actorId, sessionId, sourceMessageId) via reserveGenerationOperation/finalizeGenerationOperation RPCs (activeContext.ts), preventing duplicate generation on retried/duplicate requests.

fallbackPath.details: validateEliseGenerationOutput falls back to a caller-supplied fallbackText when model output is empty or fails validation (validationOutcome: 'fallback'). Ownership/absence prose safety guards (eliseOwnershipProseSafety.ts) drop unsafe sentences and, if nothing survives, substitute a caller-supplied neutralFallback string — never a rewritten claim.

visualInput.details: EliseVisualContextEnvelope / EliseVisualEvidence types and serializeEliseVisualContextPrompt confirm Elise supports typed visual-evidence context (scanned/attached/current-scan items), but this is a TYPED evidence envelope serialized to text for the prompt, not raw image bytes forwarded verbatim by this repo's own code inspected here.
visualInput.verdict: VISUAL GROUNDING: SUPPORTED BY PRODUCT (typed evidence pipeline exists in source). V1 harness evaluation: OUT OF SCOPE per spec section 49 (no deterministic committed replay seam exists in this lane; no real user images used).

multiTurn.evidence: style_chat_sessions / style_chat_messages tables (validateSessionOwnership, validateSourceMessageOwnership in activeContext.ts) persist conversation state; contextMessages.ts selects a bounded recent-message window (excluding greeting rows) as model context for every turn.
